text:
sarah: Heads-up: Finance and Product agreed on a metering harmonization change. Effective 2026-07-01. Aim: clearer invoice line items, a short grace window for overages, and cleaner console signals so customers can avoid surprises. TL;DR below.

ron: Can you list the concrete behavior that will change? Need to update SDK docs and Console warnings.

sarah: Summary: (1) Overages will be billed at the published tier rate with a 72-hour grace window before hard throttle for pay-as-you-go accounts. (2) Free/trial accounts keep 24-hour grace then soft-throttle. (3) Invoices will break out "base quota", "overage tokens", and "promo adjustments" as separate line items.

finance-bot: FYI: Batch invoice generation for affected customers scheduled 2026-07-02T02:30Z.

alex: Engineering ask: new headers needed (`x-grace-remaining`, `x-overage-rate`) and an event `metering_grace_started`. We'll add a job to backfill `last_billed_at`.

support: Can we surface an in-console banner at 72/24 hours remaining? Support wants a one-click retry payment link for billed overages.

sarah: Yes to both. We'll add a CTA and a short help center article that explains grace behavior and billing line items. Also: grandfathered promos are excluded from auto-invoice until their promo expiry date.

ron: Any expected customer impact? Finance estimates minor short-term revenue uptick and fewer surprise throttles.

sarah: Correct. We'll run a comms sequence: internal 2026-06-15 -> customer preview email 2026-06-22 -> enforcement 2026-07-01.

finance-bot: Reminder: please label any manual credit adjustments with the tag `grace_period_comp` for auditability.

alex: I'll open PRs for the header changes and the metering job. Also need a migration to recompute `monthly_used_tokens` snapshots for the last 90 days.

support: Drafting playbook for grace-period escalations and charge disputes.

sarah: Thanks  marketing + support + eng + finance to finalize messaging by 2026-06-18. We'll post the public FAQ on 2026-06-22.
